chapter.verse: Ahi zongin hih thu na phawk in: hunleni nunungte sungah a lauhuai hun a kisehte hong tung ding hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh mite pen amau bek a kikhual, sum a duh, a kisial, a kisathei, mi a simmawhpau, nute pate' thu a manglo, lungdamna a theilo, biakna a awlmawhlo,
khualna a neilo, thumtheih leptheih ahilo, mi a gendai nuam, pumpi ki-uklah, a guhgam, thuhoih a lunggulhlo,
a ciampel, lungsim-a suak bangin a gen a hawm, a kipumphatsak, Pasian it lo-in gualnopna a masak,
a melsuah ah biakna lungsim neihtuak napi a vangliatna tha a nial, hiding uh hi. Tua bang mite peel in.
A hang pen tua mite kimkhat mite' inn ah hawh khiankhian uh a, mawhna tawh a kivukcip, cilesa lunggulhna tuamtuam a nei numei thanemte thuzawh uh hi.
Tua numeite in thu sinsin napi-in thumaan thutak a cingtaakin thei zo ngeilo uh hi.
Jannes leh Jambres in Moses a langpan bang lianin a tunga mite in zong thumaan thutak langpang uh a, amau pen lungsim a kisia, upna lamah tehcinglo ahi uh hi.
Ahi zongin hih mi nihte mah bangin a tunga mite zong a haivaina uh vekpi' mai-ah kitheikhia ding ahih manin gamlapi tungto lo ding uh hi.
Nang na hihleh ka hilhcianna, ka gamtat luhek, ka ngimna, ka upna, ka lungduaina, ka itna, ka thuakzawhna cihte citaktak nong zui hi.
Antioch khua, Iconium khua leh Lystra khuate-a ka tuahkhak bawlsiatnate leh gimthuaknate zong na thei hi. Hih bawlsiatnate ka thuak a, tuate khempeuh pan Topa in hong honkhia hi.
A taktakin Khris Jesu sungah biakna lungsim tawh a nungta nuam khempeuh a kibawlsia ding mah hi a,
lungsim a sia mite leh a kineihkhemte ahihleh mi a khem bek hilo-in amau zong khem thuakin a siazaw lam manawh ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin nang na hihleh na sinsa thu leh na lungmuansa thu ah kip paisuak in. Tuate kua' kianga na sin cih ahi zongin,
Khris Jesu upna tawh hotkhiatna ngah nadingin hong pilsak thei biakna laite na neu tuung panin a thei na hihlam ahi zongin, na theih ahi hi.
Pasian' Laibu khempeuh Pasian' humop hi a, thuhilhna, a khialte phawksakna, khialhnate puahphatna, leh dikna thu ah kipattahna cihte ah manpha hi.
Tua pen Pasian' mi ahite, nahoih sepna namkim ah kigingin a tehcing a suah nading ahi hi.
